Br.</ls>) .²1 A day (including day and night); अहः शब्दोऽपि अहोरात्रवचनः . रात्रिशब्दोऽपि . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 8. 1. 16</ls>. अघाहानि <ls>Ms. 5. 84</ls>. .²2 Day time सव्यापारामहनि न तथा पीडयेन्मद्वियोगः <ls>Me. 90</ls>; यदह्ना कुरुते पापम् by day; अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः <ls>Bg. 8. 54</ls>. .²3 The sky (as traversed by the sun); समारूढे च मध्यमह्नः सवितरि <ls>K. 99</ls>; <ls>M. 2</ls>. .²4 A sacrificial or festival day. .²5 A dayʼs work. .²6 Viṣṇu. .²7 Night. .²8 A portion of a book appointed for a day. .²9 A day personified as one of the eight Vasus. .{@-नी@} (<ab>du.</ab>) Day and night (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab> अहन् is changed to अहः, -हं or to अह्न; see <ls>P. V. 4. 88-91</ls>, <ls n="P.">VI. 3. 110</ls>, <ls n="P.">VIII. 4. 7</ls>. {%Note%}: At the beginning of <ab>comp.</ab> it assumes the forms अहस् or अहर्; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} सप्ताहः, एकाहः, पूर्वाह्णः, अपराह्णः पुण्याहं, सुदिनाहं, अहःपतिः or अहर्पतिः <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>&c.</ab>).
